name: paypal-webhook-id-not-required-for-checkout
hook: PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID is only needed for webhook signature verification
body: PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID should be optional in getPaymentEnv(). It is only used by verifyPayPalWebhook() for verifying incoming webhook signatures, NOT by createPayPalOrder() or any other checkout-related function. Making it required broke checkout in environments where the webhook ID wasn't configured.
why: Commit fe4683821 changed PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID from optional to required in getPaymentEnv(). Since getPaymentEnv() is called by getPayPalApiBase() which is called during checkout session creation, any missing PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID caused a 500 error instead of a proper 503.
